Matas Buzelis scored the Bulls' first basket more than anyone in 2025-26: 19 times in 77 starts, or 25% of the games they started. Nikola Vucevic was next with 10. The Bulls made the game's first field goal in 33% of their 82 games and won 36% of their opening tipoffs. Everything below is counted from the play-by-play of every 2025-26 game (1,225 regular season, 85 playoffs, 6 play-in).
